name: 94708 · Berkeley, CA
findings: ZIP 94708 (Berkeley) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94708 (Berkeley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
